description: Phase 6 ownership proof (PLAN.md Phase 6): one inert tag on one AC-only imported resource, added by one reviewed CDK update and removed by a second. The execution role gets exactly these writes on exactly this resource for each update, then goes back to the read-only base. Each update's CloudTrail writes are checked against its variant.
grantNotes: The ECR update handler's write set: the tag calls, and the three calls that rewrite declared values unchanged (phase-5-import-writes.json, finding 3). A write made before a later denial is not rolled back, so both updates get the complete set. Lifecycle, encryption and deletion are never granted.
